content.title: Who is Cori Close's husband? Inside the UCLA coach's private life
content.text: During her tenure as the head coach of the UCLA Bruins, Cori Close has transitioned the program into becoming one of the best in the country, securing the 2025 Big Ten Tournament title and leading the team deep into the 2026 March Madness run.To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoYet, as her professional success is notorious, many wonder who the support figure is behind the scenes. Specifically, they ask themselves: Is Cori Close married?Cori Close's marital statusDespite the frequent searches and curiosity, Cori Close is not married. In an era where many public figures offer a 24/7 window into their homes via Instagram or reality TV, Close has remained remarkably discreet. Born on July 29, 1971, the Milpitas native has dedicated the majority of her life to the hardwood. First, she was a standout point guard at UC Santa Barbara and later entered the coaching ranks at Florida State and UCLA.Close has occasionally addressed her romantic status with a mix of humor and refreshing vulnerability. On the UCLA Women's Basketball website's "Meet the Coach" feature, she once jokingly listed "finding a husband" as an item on her bucket list. More recently, in 2026, she spoke candidly about the sacrifices of a top-tier coaching career, noting that it often feels "easier for men to have it all than for women."Who is her real support figure? While there is no husband in the picture, Close is far from being alone. The true pillar of her private life is her mother, Patti Close, affectionately known to the team as "Mother Bruin." Since Cori took the head coaching job in 2011, Patti has been a constant fixture at games, often sitting near the bench and even traveling with the team to international destinations like Europe and Africa. Following the passing of Cori's father, Don, a few years ago, the bond between mother and daughter has only strengthened.As the Bruins continue their pursuit for a national championship in 2026, Close remains focused on the family she has built on the court. While the search for a partner might still be on her bucket list, her legacy as a leader, daughter, and mentor is already firmly cemented.
